title: feat(plugin-auth,platform-objects): per-provider SSO sign-in options; invite_only refuses an uninvited SSO sign-in unless the provider allows JIT
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XHR2BUbd1Pb1WoomJ6MRTiD)_

Refs #30967

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：每个 SSO 提供方（SAML / OIDC）多两个开关，默认关闭：允许 IdP 发起的登录（allowIdpInitiated）、允许即时开通账号（allowJit）；`invite_only` 下没有账号也没有邀请的人通过 SSO 登录会被拒绝（SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED），除非该提供方打开 allowJit。
- 为什么改：按裁决 A（记录 6718355623）落地 #30967 第 1、2、4 项；只暴露 `@better-auth/sso` 已有的能力，不新增登录机制；第 3 项（组映射）不做。
- 风险与回滚：`invite_only` 是默认受众策略，已用 SSO 自动开户的部署，新用户首次登录会被拒；对应提供方打开 allowJit 即恢复旧行为。回滚即 revert 本 PR，两个新列可留在库里无害。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/audience-posture.ts`（`decideAudienceAdmission` 的 provider 分支）、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-sign-in-options.ts`（SAML 请求作用域 getter 与 OIDC 读写两半）、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`（`runSsoCallback` 的 SAML 作用域）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/plugins/plugin-auth && pnpm vitest run src/sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts src/sso-oidc-refusal-cause.test.ts`，预期全绿，其中关闭时 302 `unsolicited_response` / `state_not_found`，`invite_only` 未受邀 302 `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Two options per SSO provider, both off by default** (ruling A, record 6718355623).

- `sys_sso_provider` gains `allow_idp_initiated` and `allow_jit`: boolean, default false, `trackHistory`. They are declared to `@better-auth/sso` as `schema.ssoProvider.additionalFields`, so the vendor's own `/sso/register` and `/sso/update-provider` accept them, typed: a non-boolean answers 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`.
- No new writer population. The writers are the ones that write a provider today: the platform-admin registration gate on register, and the vendor's provider-access check on update-provider, with held callers refused as before.
- Setup: the SSO Providers list shows both, and each row has an **Edit Sign-In Options** action (`edit_sso_sign_in_options`, POST `/api/v1/auth/sso/update-provider`). It declares no `ai` block, so it is human-only under ADR-0011.

**IdP-initiated sign-in (items 1 and 2).** Only the vendor's own mechanism runs; nothing new is added.

- **SAML.** The vendor reads one plugin-wide `saml.allowIdpInitiated` while it validates a Response (`validateInResponseTo`). plugin-auth now hands it an options object whose `allowIdpInitiated` is a getter. The getter answers the value `AuthManager.runSsoCallback` put in an `AsyncLocalStorage` scope for this ACS request: the provider row's column, read through a system-context reader before the vendor runs. With no scope (any other path) it answers false.
- **OIDC.** The vendor reads `provider.oidcConfig.allowIdpInitiated` in `bounceIfIdpInitiated`, and its register and update schemas strip that member from a body. So the column is the only place it is authored:
  - on read, the objectql adapter writes the column's value into the OIDC blob it hands the vendor;
  - on write, it strips the member from the stored blob, so the update-provider merge cannot write a second copy back.
- Off answers as today: SAML 302 `error=unsolicited_response`, OIDC 302 `error=state_not_found`, and nobody is signed in.

**Unknown users under `invite_only` (item 4).**

- `decideAudienceAdmission`'s provider branch now refuses an `@better-auth/sso` creation (source `sso-oidc` / `sso-saml`) under `invite_only` when the provider's `allowJit` is off. It refuses with the existing ledger code `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`, which the vendor rethrows to the redirect's `error=`.
- These are still admitted: the bootstrap carve-out, a pending invitation, and a provider with `allowJit` on.
- A source naming no provider reads every option OFF, and so does an unreadable row.
- `email_domain`, `open`, an invalid posture, and enterprise `oidcProviders` (oauth) answer as before.
- The changeset says plainly that this is a behaviour change for existing `invite_only` deployments, and it names the `allowJit` escape hatch.

Docs: a new **Per-provider sign-in options** section in `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx`. i18n: the new labels, help texts and action strings are translated in all six locale bundles.

## Tests

All new pins sit in the existing harness files as top-level describes (shared-harness ruling 6583487846), plus one new unit file.

- `sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts` (real samlify IdP):
  - IdP-initiated off: 302 `unsolicited_response`, no session.
  - On: the same Response signs the person in.
  - Another provider's toggle does not open this one.
  - CONTROL: SP-initiated sign-in.
  - JIT under `invite_only`: refused 302 `{ base: sign-in-failed, error: SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED }` and no user is created; `allowJit` admits.
  - CONTROLs: an invited user; the `open` posture.
- `sso-oidc-refusal-cause.test.ts`:
  - Off: 302 `state_not_found`.
  - On: bounces to the IdP's authorize with a fresh state, and finishing the flow signs the person in.
  - A value smuggled into the stored blob is not read, and an adapter update strips it.
  - JIT refused, with `allowJit`, invited and `email_domain` legs, as for SAML.
- `sso-register-platform-admin-gate.test.ts` (real SQL):
  - Default off.
  - The owner's update-provider turns each toggle on and off, and the store reads it back.
  - A non-boolean answers 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, and nothing is written.
  - A member who is not the provider's writer answers 403, and nothing is written.
- `plugin-audit/audit-internal-field-omission.test.ts`: both declarations are boolean, `trackHistory` and default false. Flipping each toggle 0→1→0 writes two `sys_audit_log` update rows, each carrying both sides, and two `updated` activity rows naming the field.
- `audience-posture.test.ts`: the decision matrix, with CONTROL rows for `email_domain`, `open`, invalid posture and `oidcProviders`.
- `sso-sign-in-options.test.ts`: the declaration; the reader (the 1/0 carrier, fail-closed); source classification; OIDC read and write; the SAML getter's scope, including two concurrent scopes.
- `objectql-adapter.test.ts`: the snake/camel read pin now expects the injected `allowIdpInitiated: false` in the OIDC blob.

<details><summary>Red first, then each negative pin ablated</summary>

- **Red first.** With the seven production files at the base commit (the new module left in place, unwired), 14 pins go red across the six files: 11 in plugin-auth and 3 in plugin-audit. The default-off and CONTROL pins stay green, as they should, because off was already the vendor's default.
- **Ablations.** Each was run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which mutates the file on disk, runs the tests and restores the file:

| Ablation | Red |
|---|---|
| SAML getter forced `true` | SAML off pin, another-provider pin, scope unit pin |
| OIDC read forced `true` | OIDC off pin, smuggled-value pin, read unit pin |
| OIDC read line deleted | OIDC on pin, smuggled-value pin, read unit pin |
| strip-on-write deleted | smuggled-value pin, write unit pin |
| JIT gate forced `false` | SAML and OIDC refusal pins, two matrix pins |
| `allow_jit` `trackHistory: false` | declaration pin |

The ledger rows themselves do not depend on `trackHistory`: plugin-audit mirrors every engine write. The flag is pinned by the declaration pin.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **ADR-0011 not edited.** It is a governed surface. The new action has no `ai` block, so it is human-only, as `list_platform_admins` is.
- **The env-side bridges do not forward the toggles.** `/admin/sso/register` and `register-saml` do not pass them on, so a provider registered through Setup starts with both off and is then edited with Edit Sign-In Options. The vendor's own register takes both members.
- **Enterprise `oidcProviders` (genericOAuth) are untouched.** Their JIT stays admitted under every posture, as before.
- **Invalid posture is unchanged.** An off-vocabulary posture admits a provider-class creation as before, and only a valid `invite_only` judges `allowJit`. A CONTROL row pins this.
- **Item 3 (group mapping) is excluded**, per the order.
- **Serial constraint with #30959.** Whichever of the two lands second merges `origin/main` once and reruns the plugin-auth and platform-objects suites.
